title: Mujadara
author: farag4m

step.title: Saute onions
step.text: Using Saute mode, cook the sliced onions in olive oil until deeply golden brown. Remove and set aside.

step.title: Cook lentils
step.text: Add 1 cup lentils, 1.5 cups water, 1/2 teaspoon salt, and cumin. Pressure cook on High for 5 minutes, then quick release.

step.title: Add rice
step.text: Add 2 cups rinsed rice, 3 cups water, remaining salt and spices, and an optional drizzle of olive oil. Stir once.

step.title: Final cook
step.text: Pressure cook on High for 8 minutes, then natural release for 10 minutes.

step.title: Add onions
step.text: Mix most of the browned onions into the rice and lentils, then top with the remaining onions.

notes: Pressure-cooker-only recipe. Use the pressure cooker's Saute mode for the onions.
